title: Pride & Joy #2 of 4 DC Vertigo August 1997 Garth Ennis John Higgins
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Pride & Joy #2 of 4 (August 1997), DC/Vertigo. Written by Garth Ennis (Preacher, The Boys), art and cover by John Higgins. Suggested for mature readers.

Back cover: Batman & Robin movie poster ad (Clooney, Schwarzenegger, Thurman, Silverstone).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
